description: This PHP class 'Content' manages content pages in a documentation or static site generator system, handling front matter parsing, navigation links, and content attributes.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Represents a content node with front matter parsing, navigation, and attribute management, extending ContentAbstract.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Content object with a parent directory, URI, and optional file info.

methods.name: getFrontMatter
methods.description: Parses the front matter section of the content, handling BOM removal.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content string, parsing attributes if necessary.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content manually, marking it as manually set.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous Content object linked.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next Content object linked.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Checks if this content is the index page based on configuration.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title from attributes or falls back to parent title.

methods.name: parseAttributes
methods.description: Parses front matter and content attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute or all if no key provided.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns an array summarizing the content, including navigation and attributes.
